title: Calling functions across lists
description: You can compare map, apply and a direct lambda call.

steps.description: You define two three-element lists. map subtracts corresponding elements, producing (-3 -3 -3).
apply spreads the list (1 2 3) into the arguments of +. This call produces the single value 6.

steps.question: What does the square lambda produce when map visits 1 through 5?
steps.answer: It produces the list (1 4 9 16 25), one squared result per input element.

steps.description: You see the squared list followed by 25. The final expression calls the lambda directly with 5, producing one value.
